URL_policy: Use a literal documented target only with scoped source evidence; otherwise reserved .example hostname with no label-coded words. Never fetch message destinations. Illustrative URLs cannot measure real URL-model quality.
selection_policy: Fixed catalog positions, one injection and three robustness variants per source; no prediction, seed reroll or selection by model outcome.
analysis_units: 240 primary authored bases;40 paired injection variants;120 robustness variants. These are400 rows, not400 independent received messages.
test_policy: Author-exposed holdout; not independent blind test. Do not tune on holdout. Existing120SMSreserve stays untouched.
reporting: Primary vs injection vs robustness separately; report source components, URL provenance, labels pending people, source/RAG/historical overlap and coverage/errors. No claim of human authorship or accuracy from this collection.
